description: Land Acquisition - Compensation for the acquisition of the land in Divulapitiya D/S Division
categorisation: This gazette notice is a Land Acquisition Notice published under the Land Acquisition Act. It specifically deals with the statutory compensation for a specific plot of land (Polhenawatta, Lot 251) acquired for the state, including details of its location, extent, and the deposit of compensation. The content is exclusively focused on land and property-related matters, fitting the definition of a Land Gazette.
